title: Synthesis, characterization, and catalytic performance in 1-butene cracking of ZSM-5 zeolites prepared with different cross-linked silicon species
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23651-23661
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08160B, Paper

Zhen Chen, Jingfei Geng, Xiaofang Chen, Na Li, Richuan Rao, Xiongzi Dong, Haiping Zou, Weihang Ou
C-ZSM-5 zeolites, featuring enhanced hydrophobicity, higher surface Al content, relatively weak acid strength, and Al concentrated in straight/sinusoidal channels, offer superior propylene selectivity, a higher P/E ratio, and fewer by-products.
